plan_origin: TEST-authored goal()/DAG helper, not an AI-generated or live-provider plan
sources: Pinned public capture fixture used only as isolated test input; no production fixture fallback

queries.dependency_read: MATCH (:PlanRevision {id:$plan})-[:HAS_STEP]->(s:GoalStep) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(d:GoalStep) RETURN s.step_id,collect(d.step_id) ORDER BY s.step_id
queries.citation_read: MATCH (:PlanRevision {id:$plan})-[:HAS_STEP]->(s:GoalStep) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:CITES]->(e:GoalEvidence) RETURN s.step_id,collect(e.id) ORDER BY s.step_id

dependency_ablation.reason: Native plan dependency or step binding changed

selected_source_mutation.mutation: Appended a test-only comment to the selected cached source content

engine.engine_origin: Official Redis/FalkorDB binary started on a random localhost port by the release_engine test fixture

limits: Tests establish native graph readiness and selected-fact freshness enforcement, not semantic goal interpretation or useful AI planning.
Source fixtures and the test-authored plan do not constitute live Groq or provider evidence.
